message: These small, checksummed historical examples support the notebooks. Use the archive file index below to discover all 52,277 files in the three current Level 2 API projects. This example snapshot does not certify mission-wide scientific completeness.

releases.citation: Odin-SMR, ALL-Strat-v3.0.0, frequency mode 1, O3-501GHz-20to50km and associated retrieval diagnostics. Parquet example snapshot odin-parquet-examples-20261113. Cite the selected file SHA256 values and consult the linked product documentation for scientific references.
